# Exercise 10: Time Series Workflow

This exercise combines several methods from the module.

---

## Task 1: Generate Your Own Time Series

Create a time series with:

- 10 days, hourly frequency
- Trend
- Daily seasonality
- Noise
- At least 3 anomalies

Visualize the time series.

---

## Task 2: Validation

Intentionally introduce errors:

- Duplicates
- Missing values
- Unsorted timestamps

Implement a proper validation.

---

## Task 3: Resampling

- Aggregate to daily averages.
- Compare original and aggregated series.
- Interpret the information loss.

---

## Task 4: Smoothing

- Test rolling windows of 6H, 24H, 72H.
- What structure becomes visible in each case?

---

## Task 5: Anomalies

- Implement an EWMA baseline.
- Detect anomalies.
- Vary the threshold.

---

## Task 6: Forecast Baselines

- Train-test split (80/20)
- Naive
- Seasonal Naive (24H)
- MA(24)

Compare the MAE values and interpret the results.

---

::: {.callout-note title="Submission Format (optional)"}
Plots + brief interpretation (bullet points).
:::
